findings.summary: Any read or JSON-decode error of the main training state is treated as a lease change and latches the evaluation.
findings.trigger: A non-atomic in-place write of learning/runs/v2-orchestration/state.json (orchestrator edits or heartbeat writes; no atomic writer for these is in the repo) is caught mid-write by an observer poll (observe.py:276) or worker check (worker.py:37, binding.py:233).
findings.consequence: json decode error -> observe.py:277 latches lease_changed and kills the single evaluation attempt; worker fails; finished receipts only; attempt is spent and a new reviewed registration is needed. Training is not affected.
findings.fix: Retry main-state reads on decode/OS errors (bounded, e.g. 3 reads over <=1 s) before latching; keep the unregistered-campaign latch unchanged. Add a fake test where the main-state file is torn for one poll and the run must continue. Alternatively require atomic writes for state.json and record that as a precondition.

findings.summary: ObserverRun success cases use a fake clock that steps 50 s from begin=WORK-30 past term_at=WORK; they pass only if the stub child is reaped before the second poll.
findings.trigger: Child start-up time exceeds the first loop iteration under load (same pattern as r2 finding 1, carried forward; static analysis only, not reproduced because tests were not run).
findings.consequence: Intermittent test failure with first_event external_work_deadline.
findings.fix: Use smaller fake-clock steps near term_at, or wait for child exit before the first poll in the test.

findings.summary: All ObserverRun tests inject clock, so use_timer is False and the real ITIMER_REAL/SIGALRM arm, post-loop re-arm and restore are never exercised (carried from r2 finding 2).
findings.trigger: A defect in the real timer path on the first real run.
findings.consequence: Timeout handling defect would only surface during the real evaluation.
findings.fix: Add a Darwin-arm64 real-timer case with WORK=2 s and a real-timer success case (test-only; observe.py unchanged).

findings.summary: If the process dies after parent-terminal-audit.json is durably saved and before clear_own_lease completes, a re-run is refused and the own lease stays active with no documented recovery.
findings.trigger: Crash or kill between audit.py:74 and audit.py:75 (clear_own_lease at audit.py:40).
findings.consequence: Own ledger active_evaluation_lease remains set; monitor reports own_lease_active; ledger spent, so no new launch is possible. Main training state is unaffected.
findings.fix: Document a manual recovery step that clears only the exact own lease after verifying the audit hash, or make the audit re-run idempotent for this case.

findings.summary: The 3x wall factor is not measured under concurrent training; the prior timing was not taken with a shared GPU.
findings.trigger: Shared MPS/GPU slowdown above about 3x the prior rate (prior 684.92 s for 15,487,746 raw frames).
findings.consequence: Work deadline at 7352 s stops the run (fail-closed); finished receipts are kept; attempt is spent.
findings.fix: Disclose as a limit in the calibration acceptance; the acceptance must restate work 7352, postflight 120, total 7482 (carried r2 finding 3).

findings.summary: Package worker.py and clean-source worker.py share a module name; binding.contracts() inserts SOURCE at sys.path[0] (binding.py:167-168).
findings.trigger: Any import of the bare name 'worker' after contracts() has run; the clean worker_cli.py does `import worker` (progressive1000-opening-maintenance-runtime-parent-20261027-r1/worker_cli.py:20), though no current flow in this package imports it.
findings.consequence: Latent: would load the clean worker instead of the package worker.
findings.fix: Keep the current flow; optionally assert in binding that worker is not imported from SOURCE.

findings.summary: The ~650 KB main state is fully parsed on each observer poll (about every 0.1 s, observe.py:297) and each worker check (about every 0.2 s, binding.py:233-239).
findings.consequence: Extra CPU during a shared run; does not affect correctness.
findings.fix: Cache by (mtime_ns, size) or lengthen the poll interval for the main-state check only.
